evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Exact HfRu3H/HRu3Hf superconductivity queries on 2026-10-07 identified no experimental superconducting exact ordered phase. The MC2023 published prediction is acknowledged prior, and only the matched Hf-for-V source hypothesis is proposed as new to this reviewed catalogue.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Hydrogen zero-point/anharmonic and vacancy/decomposition energetics, ordering entropy and Hf/Ru SOC may alter the prediction. The actual target has no signed negative finite-path value and positive Gamma optical compression. Ti3HfH is better at all ten lambda values and remains a retained negative control for the claim of globally optimal chemistry; it does not contradict the narrower Hf-for-V hypothesis.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=-0.056 GPa, full max stress=0.056 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Hf replaces V on the unique cage-corner cation site with the three Ru and one H roles retained. Cell volume rises 10.763%, H-Ru distance rises 0.0660796 A and Hf-Ru versus V-Ru rises 0.0934507 A. This coupled cation/network construction increases source lambda across all ten sigma values; it is not an expansion-only causal attribution.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare HfRu3H and VRu3H at a common cage volume, identical PP/cutoff and q/k sampling, and include H vacancy/decomposition or anharmonic stability evidence. Persistence of the lambda gain supports the coupled construction; collapse of the gain or a nontranslation soft branch opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
